subject: CloudHaven renewal: term change & capacity rebalance
messages:
From: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@cloudhaven.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Pruitt <alex.pruitt@cloudhaven.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Renewal planning — term tweak + capacity redistribution

Markus,

Thanks for the call today. CloudHaven is aligned to move forward for another term but we want to make two adjustments before sign:

1) Term length: we prefer an 18-month extension instead of 12 to match our project runway.
2) Capacity rebalance: shift 30% of committed GPU capacity from the Hosted pool to a Dedicated pool for steady inference (we still want burst to hosted during spikes).

Attached is a short note with our requested billing cadence and an initial marked Order Form (v5). Our legal team also started a pass on Exhibit D (data residency & logs) and attached their marked PDF for your legal review.

Can you confirm pricing impact and next steps for getting a clean order form back to us? We are aiming to execute before Oct 20 so the project can start Nov 1.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if it helps.

Emily Zhou
Head of ML Ops
CloudHaven

Attachments: CloudHaven_Renewal_Request_20261005.pdf, CloudHaven_OrderForm_v5.docx, MSA_Exhibit_D_marked.pdf

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@cloudhaven.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — term tweak + capacity redistribution

Emily — thanks for the clear note and the marked attachments. High-level yes on both items; I ran preliminary numbers with pricing and there are two things to confirm:

- Term: moving to 18 months keeps unit pricing the same but we need to update the billing schedule in the Order Form (annual invoice vs. monthly).
- Capacity rebalance: Dedicated reservation increases the committed monthly minimum; we can keep a burst-to-hosted overlay for spikes, which protects your latency SLOs.

I’ve looped in Monica (CS) for staging/onboarding details and Rishi (legal) for the Exhibit D redlines and indemnity language. Monica — can you confirm effort/timeline for migrating the 30% footprint to Dedicated without disrupting the Nov 1 go-live? Rishi — if you can take a first pass on the Exhibit D items Emily flagged, we’ll iterate with CloudHaven Legal.

Next steps I propose:
- Redwood to provide an updated Order Form v5.1 with the 18-month term and revised billing cadence.
- Legal exchange on Exhibit D redlines (we’ll try to track only scope-specific changes; highlight any new obligations).
- DocuSign link once we have agreed order form.

I’ll send the v5.1 later today.

Thanks,

Markus Klein
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0182

From: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@cloudhaven.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudHaven Legal <legal@cloudhaven.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — term tweak + capacity redistribution

On Tue, Oct 5, 2026 at 11:03 AM Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com> wrote:
> Emily — thanks for the clear note and the marked attachments. High-level yes on both items; I ran preliminary numbers with pricing and there are two things to confirm:

Thanks Markus — appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple of targeted legal asks from our counsel after their pass:

- Exhibit D: they want clarification that log retention for inference requests will be limited to 90 days unless explicitly requested for incident investigation; their redline removes the open-ended retention clause.
- Indemnity carve: they request narrow language around model outputs (no implied IP transfer).

Commercially we accept the 18-month term if the unit pricing and the committed monthly minimum for Dedicated can be capped (we ask for an escape if sustained usage drops below 50% for a 2-month rolling window). Can you confirm whether Redwood can offer a one-time credit if we transition capacity back to hosted within the first 6 months?

Alex and I are available for a 30-min legal+commercial sync tomorrow Pacific.

Emily

Attachments: MSA_Exhibit_D_marked.pdf

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@cloudhaven.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, CloudHaven Legal <legal@cloudhaven.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — term tweak + capacity redistribution

Emily / Alex / CloudHaven legal — following our internal review I’ve attached a clean Order Form v5.1 and a short commentary on the Exhibit D redlines. Quick summary of our positions: 

- Retention: Redwood is willing to accept a 90-day default retention for inference request logs for the Dedicated environment; we’ll add a clause for forensic hold requests (subject to prior notice and costs).
- Indemnity/IP: We cannot accept broad output indemnities that imply ownership; we propose tightened language that clarifies outputs remain with CloudHaven and Redwood disclaims implied ownership claims for pre-trained model weights.
- Billing & credits: We can cap the committed monthly minimum for the first 6 months and provide a one-time transition credit (10% of one month’s committed fee) if CloudHaven elects to move capacity back to Hosted within that window.

Monica — team will need the onboarding runbook updated for a phased Dedicated handover the week of Nov 1. Can you confirm resourcing?

Next actions:
1) CloudHaven legal to confirm Exhibit D redline acceptance or propose counterlanguage.
2) CloudHaven to confirm acceptance of Order Form v5.1.
3) I’ll create a DocuSign packet for the MSA + Order Form once legal confirms Exhibit D.

DocuSign (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/templates/CH-4921-orderform
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/CH-4921

Thanks everyone — happy to get a 30-min sync on calendar if useful.

Best,

Markus Klein
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: CloudHaven_OrderForm_v5.1.docx, ExhibitD_Commentary_20261012.pdf
